record: The frozen staging/QA schema the forward-migration checks are run against. Captured read-only on 2026-10-06 by scripts/backup-database.mjs (the previous 2026-09-30 capture predates marketplace migrations 0184-0187 being applied to QA, so it no longer matched the server). It is a logical dump and DOES contain real rows, so it lives only in gitignored backups/; the verification tool loads its schema and skips every data statement. Staging IS the ledgered migrate target for forward files; this baseline lets a change be checked before the ledger apply.
dataNote: Measured with the project splitter: 3316 statements total, 2267 of them data (2267 rows across 56 dumped tables). Contains personal data and password hashes — never commit, never publish. The tool re-measures this count and refuses the record if it does not match.

ledgerOnServer.note: At capture time (2026-10-06). The ledger was adopted to 169 files on 2026-10-01 (PHASE_2_MIGRATION_LEDGER.md) and 0176-0187 were applied forward since; 0188-0195 were still pending on the server at capture.

policy.note: New files are verified here first, then applied forward through scripts/migrate.mjs so the ledger records what actually ran.
